subject: math
description: Calculate the volume of square pyramids by identifying the square base area, using the vertical height, and writing answers with correct cubic units.
learningObjectives: Identify the side length of the square base and the vertical height of a square pyramid
Use V = (1/3)s^2h to calculate the volume of a square pyramid
Distinguish vertical height from slant height in pyramid volume problems
Write pyramid volume answers with appropriate cubic units
prerequisites: Find the area of a square using side times side
Recognize cubic units as volume units
Understand that a pyramid has one base and triangular side faces
